title: Enquirer’s Guide: What is a Referent?
summary: It is the proposed deeper counterpart of an ordinary object.
author: The Enquirer’s Guide Desk
paragraphs: This entry from The Enquirer’s Guide answers a question often put to the Society: “What is a Referent?”
It is the proposed deeper counterpart of an ordinary object.

When researchers alter an object’s shape, its faint Eidetic measurements may change; what that tells us about the Referent is still debated. It need not be a perfect copy, and no one has shown that every Referent exists independently.

Readers should treat the answer as an introduction rather than a final authority. Eidetic science in Alderwick is reported through measurements, disputed interpretations and careful revisions, and a respectable enquiry may properly end with further questions.
